notes:
What's new in 0.25.0

• Movie Night Match (Discover): everyone scans the code and swipes yes or no on their phone. The first film or series you all say yes to is the match.
• New Home rows: Comfort Rewatch, Under 90 Minutes, Hidden Gems and Something Different (a new genre each time).
• Rabbit Hole: the first card under More Like This. Follow suggestions as far as you like; Back retraces your steps.
• Cast & Crew on every title page. Pick someone to see everything they've been in, with what you've seen ticked.
• Zylo Wrapped (Discover, needs Trakt): your year in hours, films, episodes, biggest binge, top genres and more.
• Calendar (Discover): new episodes and films over the next four weeks. Hold OK for a reminder on the day.
• Thumbs up or down: asked when a film ends, and under Overview on any title. Up adds a "Because You Liked" row; down keeps it out of your rows. Sent to Trakt as a rating.
• Pause screen: paused for a few seconds, the picture dims and shows what you're watching.
• The next episode's sources are found during the last few minutes, so Up Next starts it straight away.
• Anime series now only appear in the Anime section (and in search).
